missed_slot_policy: Record MISSED; do not backdate or catch up as if timely. Later same-day slots can provide genuine timely recovery.
denominator: All 20 consecutive predeclared XNYS decisions; missed/failed/late days remain failures. Future cutoffs excluded until elapsed.
pilot_pass_scope: Coverage only; source-clock approval, historical availability, S/D warmup and effectiveness remain independent gates.
runtime_policy: Local worker only; no durable scheduler available in this managed environment. Suspension/restart risks are explicit and missed days count.
